title: Keep worker scratch logs inside the run directory
body: Outcome: a worker turn's scratch logs never cause a scope violation: either the driver gives the worker a scratch directory inside its run dir (stated in the turn prompt) or `krn brief check` refuses a brief whose run dir is not the only writable `.krn/` path. Evidence: t-1svg55a round 1 exit 3 only for `.krn/runs/worker-acceptance/*.log` beside the run dir (.krn/runs/lead/worker-acceptance/rounds/001). Proof: observer red at base by assertion.
